title: Shrinking degreewise chain-equation defects
statement:
Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], P,Q cochain complexes of O_Y-modules
[def-pc-derived-category] supported in integer intervals [a,b] and [c,e], and
assume each term is zero or isomorphic to a finite free sheaf
[def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let y be a point and U an open containing y. Write
R_U for open restriction, S_U for stalk pullback into U [def-pc-derived-pullback],
and E_U for [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]. Given maps
g_n:R_U(P)^n -> R_U(Q)^n already defined on U, suppose their pullbacks satisfy
S_U(g_n) ; d_{S_U R_U Q}^{n,n+1} = d_{S_U R_U P}^{n,n+1} ; S_U(g_{n+1}).
Then there are an open V containing y with V <= U and maps
k_n:R_V(P)^n -> R_V(Q)^n satisfying all adjacent differential equations, and
S_V(k_n)=E_V(P).hom_n ; E_U(P).inv_n ; S_U(g_n) ; E_U(Q).hom_n ; E_V(Q).inv_n.
This asserts shrinking of an existing degreewise family, not extension of a
prescribed stalk family.

proof.text: Use the finite integer interval I = [max(a,c-1), min(b,e-1)]. For each n in I take the two maps g_n ; d_Q and d_P ; g_(n+1), from the restriction of P^n to the restriction of Q^(n+1). Functoriality of stalk pullback and hcomm give equality of their pullbacks. Apply the finite-family equality lemma, using the given zero-or-finite-free descriptions of both terms, to obtain V inside U containing y.

Let C be the termwise comparison from direct restriction to V to restriction through U, from restrictFunctorCongr(homOfLE_ι) and restrictFunctorComp. Define k_n = C(P).hom_n ; R_j(g_n) ; C(Q).inv_n. The chain equations on I follow by conjugating the equalities from the preceding step and applying commutativity of C(P).hom and C(Q).inv with the differentials. Outside I, integer arithmetic shows P^n is zero or Q^(n+1) is zero by one of the four support bounds. Restriction preserves zero objects, so the two maps are equal by uniqueness.
Apply the componentwise stalk comparison compatibility for the subopen V <= U to each g_n. It gives exactly the required component equation for the explicitly constructed k_n.

theorem exists_shrink_degreewise_comm_of_stalk
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (a b c e : ℤ)
    (hPa : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hPb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hQc : Q.IsStrictlyGE c) (hQe : Q.IsStrictlyLE e)
    (hPfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (P.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (Q.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y) (U : Y.Opens) (hyU : y ∈ U)
    (g : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n)
    (hcomm : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (g n) ≫
        (((Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q)).d
            n (n + 1) =
      (((Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)).d
          n (n + 1) ≫ (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (g (n + 1))) :
    ∃ (V : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyV : y ∈ V), V ≤ U ∧ ∃ (k : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, k n ≫
        (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).d
          n (n + 1) =
        (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).d
          n (n + 1) ≫ k (n + 1)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).map (k n) =
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso V y hyV).app P).hom.f n ≫
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app P).inv.f n ≫
        (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (g n) ≫
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app Q).hom.f n ≫
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso V y hyV).app Q).inv.f n)
